description: This file defines classes related to text stream termination and processing, including terminator classes for null, carriage return, and line feed, as well as a template class for stream text handling with customizable terminators. It provides mechanisms for handling text input/output, termination sequences, and data conversion, intended for use within the WPEFramework Core namespace.

classes.name: StreamTextType
classes.description: Template class for handling text streams with customizable terminators, including data sending/receiving, state management, and text processing.

methods.name: IsTerminated
methods.description: Checks if a character is a termination character based on the terminator class.

methods.name: SizeOf
methods.description: Returns the size of the terminator sequence.

methods.description: Returns the string marker for the terminator sequence.

methods.name: SendData
methods.description: Sends data over the stream, handling internal queue and termination markers.

methods.name: ReceiveData
methods.description: Processes incoming data, detects termination sequences, and triggers callbacks.

methods.name: Convert
methods.description: Converts raw data bytes to characters, handling network-to-host byte order conversion.
